description: List all surveys of the company, newest first, each with id, title, status (draft, active, closed, archived), start and end date, participant limit, anonymity threshold, participation link and edit link. Read-only. Use it to find the surveyId needed by safe_mind_get_survey and safe_mind_get_analytics. Requires an API key: set SAFE_MIND_API_KEY or call safe_mind_get_api_key first. Acts on the company of the account behind the key.
name: safe_mind_list_surveys
